ORDER BY
p.NAME_ ASC p.NAME_ DESC p.NAME_ ASC p.NAME_ DESC COALESCE(CAST(urgency.LONG_ AS VARCHAR), urgency.TEXT_) ASC COALESCE(CAST(urgency.LONG_ AS VARCHAR), urgency.TEXT_) DESC deadline.LONG_ ASC deadline.LONG_ DESC p.START_TIME_ ASC p.START_TIME_ DESC t.START_TIME_ DESC
, t.ID_ DESC

ORDER BY
p.NAME_ ASC p.NAME_ DESC p.NAME_ ASC p.NAME_ DESC COALESCE(CAST(urgency.LONG_ AS VARCHAR), urgency.TEXT_) ASC COALESCE(CAST(urgency.LONG_ AS VARCHAR), urgency.TEXT_) DESC deadline.LONG_ ASC deadline.LONG_ DESC p.START_TIME_ ASC p.START_TIME_ DESC t.END_TIME_ DESC
, t.ID_ DESC

( SELECT t.ID_ AS id, t.NAME_ AS name, def.NAME_ AS "taskName", t.START_TIME_ AS "createTime", t.END_TIME_ AS "endTime", t.DURATION_ AS "durationInMillis", t.DUE_DATE_ AS "dueDate", (SELECT COALESCE(CAST(v.LONG_ AS VARCHAR), v.TEXT_) FROM ACT_HI_VARINST v WHERE v.PROC_INST_ID_ = t.PROC_INST_ID_ AND v.NAME_ = #{VAR_URGENCY} LIMIT 1) AS "urgencyDegree", (SELECT CASE WHEN v.LONG_ IS NOT NULL THEN to_timestamp(v.LONG_ / 1000) ELSE NULL END FROM ACT_HI_VARINST v WHERE v.PROC_INST_ID_ = t.PROC_INST_ID_ AND v.NAME_ = #{VAR_DEADLINE} LIMIT 1) AS "deadlineDate", (SELECT v.TEXT_ FROM ACT_HI_VARINST v WHERE v.PROC_INST_ID_ = t.PROC_INST_ID_ AND v.NAME_ = #{VAR_SOURCE_UNIT} LIMIT 1) AS source, CAST(COALESCE((SELECT COALESCE(CAST(v.LONG_ AS VARCHAR), v.TEXT_) FROM ACT_HI_VARINST v WHERE v.TASK_ID_ = t.ID_ AND v.NAME_ = #{TASK_STATUS} LIMIT 1), '2') AS INTEGER) AS status, (SELECT v.TEXT_ FROM ACT_HI_VARINST v WHERE v.TASK_ID_ = t.ID_ AND v.NAME_ = 'reason' LIMIT 1) AS reason, t.TASK_DEF_KEY_ AS "taskDefinitionKey", t.PROC_INST_ID_ AS "processInstanceId", p.NAME_ AS "processInstanceName", p.START_TIME_ AS "processInstanceCreateTime", p.PROC_DEF_ID_ AS "processDefinitionId", def.KEY_ AS "processDefinitionKey", startUser.nickname AS "startUserNickname", assigneeUser.nickname AS "assigneeNickname", FALSE AS "isHistory", NULL AS "projectId", 'flowable' AS "sourceType", t.ID_ AS "sortId" FROM ACT_HI_TASKINST t LEFT JOIN ACT_HI_PROCINST p ON p.ID_ = t.PROC_INST_ID_ LEFT JOIN ACT_RE_PROCDEF def ON def.ID_ = t.PROC_DEF_ID_ LEFT JOIN system_users startUser ON p.START_USER_ID_ = CAST(startUser.id AS VARCHAR) LEFT JOIN system_users assigneeUser ON t.ASSIGNEE_ = CAST(assigneeUser.id AS VARCHAR) WHERE t.ASSIGNEE_ = CAST(#{userId} AS VARCHAR) AND t.END_TIME_ IS NOT NULL AND t.TASK_DEF_KEY_ != #{START_USER_NODE_ID} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ACT_HI_VARINST deletedStatus WHERE deletedStatus.PROC_INST_ID_ = t.PROC_INST_ID_ AND deletedStatus.NAME_ = #{VAR_PROCESS_STATUS} AND COALESCE(CAST(deletedStatus.LONG_ AS VARCHAR), deletedStatus.TEXT_) = '5' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ACT_HI_VARINST cancelStatus WHERE cancelStatus.TASK_ID_ = t.ID_ AND cancelStatus.NAME_ = #{TASK_STATUS} AND COALESCE(CAST(cancelStatus.LONG_ AS VARCHAR), cancelStatus.TEXT_) = '4' )
UNION ALL
SELECT CONCAT('HISTORY_TASK:', a.actinst_id) AS id, a.actinst_name AS name, CASE WHEN rd.id IS NOT NULL THEN '收文' WHEN lv.id IS NOT NULL THEN '请假管理' WHEN te.id IS NOT NULL THEN '因公外出' WHEN cf.id IS NOT NULL THEN '会议报告单' WHEN bpm.business_type = 'xzfy' THEN '行政复议' WHEN bpm.business_type = 'xzss' THEN '行政诉讼' ELSE '历史流程' END AS "taskName", a.start_date AS "createTime", a.end_date AS "endTime", CASE WHEN a.start_date IS NOT NULL AND a.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.end_date - a.start_date)) * 1000 AS BIGINT) ELSE NULL END AS "durationInMillis", a.will_finish_date AS "dueDate", CAST(p.emergency AS VARCHAR) AS "urgencyDegree", p.deadline AS "deadlineDate", COALESCE(rd.send_dept, p.responsible_dept) AS source, 2 AS status, a.actinst_comment AS reason, CAST(a.actinst_id AS VARCHAR) AS "taskDefinitionKey", CAST(p.proinst_id AS VARCHAR) AS "processInstanceId", p.proinst_name AS "processInstanceName", p.start_date AS "processInstanceCreateTime", NULL AS "processDefinitionId", CASE WHEN rd.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'receive_doc' WHEN lv.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'leave' WHEN te.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'time_explain' WHEN cf.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'confflow' WHEN bpm.business_type = 'xzfy' THEN 'xzfy' WHEN bpm.business_type = 'xzss' THEN 'xzss' ELSE 'history' END AS "processDefinitionKey", p.creator AS "startUserNickname", a.transactor AS "assigneeNickname", TRUE AS "isHistory", p.project_id AS "projectId", 'history' AS "sourceType", CAST(a.actinst_id AS VARCHAR) AS "sortId" FROM hist_wf.actinst a JOIN hist_wf.proinst p ON p.source_schema = a.source_schema AND p.proinst_id = a.proinst_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, MAX(id) AS id, MAX(send_dept) AS send_dept FROM bpm_receive_doc WHERE COALESCE(deleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY project_id ) rd ON rd.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, MAX(id) AS id FROM bpm_leave WHERE COALESCE(deleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY project_id ) lv ON lv.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, MAX(id) AS id FROM t_time_explain WHERE COALESCE(deleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY project_id ) te ON te.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, MAX(id) AS id FROM t_confflow WHERE COALESCE(deleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY project_id ) cf ON cf.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, MIN(business_type) AS business_type FROM hist_wf.biz_project_map WHERE business_type IN ('xzfy', 'xzss') GROUP BY project_id ) bpm ON bpm.project_id = p.project_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.end_date IS NOT NULL ) unified

where.if: AND ( unified."processDefinitionKey" = #{reqVO.processDefinitionKey} OR (#{reqVO.processDefinitionKey} = 'receive_doc' AND (unified."processDefinitionKey" = 'receive_doc' OR unified."taskName" LIKE '%收文%' OR unified."processInstanceName" LIKE '%收文%')) OR (#{reqVO.processDefinitionKey} = 'leave' AND (unified."processDefinitionKey" IN ('leave', 'oa_leave') OR unified."taskName" LIKE '%请假%' OR unified."processInstanceName" LIKE '%请假%')) OR (#{reqVO.processDefinitionKey} = 'time_explain' AND (unified."processDefinitionKey" = 'time_explain' OR unified."taskName" LIKE '%公出%' OR unified."taskName" LIKE '%外出%' OR unified."processInstanceName" LIKE '%公出%' OR unified."processInstanceName" LIKE '%外出%')) OR (#{reqVO.processDefinitionKey} = 'confflow' AND (unified."processDefinitionKey" = 'confflow' OR unified."taskName" LIKE '%会议%' OR unified."processInstanceName" LIKE '%会议%')) OR (#{reqVO.processDefinitionKey} = 'xzfy' AND (unified."processDefinitionKey" = 'xzfy' OR unified."taskName" LIKE '%复议%' OR unified."processInstanceName" LIKE '%复议%')) OR (#{reqVO.processDefinitionKey} = 'xzss' AND (unified."processDefinitionKey" = 'xzss' OR unified."taskName" LIKE '%诉讼%' OR unified."processInstanceName" LIKE '%诉讼%')) )
AND (unified."processInstanceId" LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.processInstanceId}, '%') OR unified."projectId" LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.processInstanceId}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM
ORDER BY
unified."processInstanceName" ASC unified."processInstanceName" DESC unified."processInstanceName" ASC unified."processInstanceName" DESC unified.name ASC unified.name DESC unified."urgencyDegree" ASC unified."urgencyDegree" DESC unified."deadlineDate" ASC unified."deadlineDate" DESC unified."processInstanceCreateTime" ASC unified."processInstanceCreateTime" DESC unified."endTime" ASC unified."endTime" DESC unified."processInstanceCreateTime" DESC
, unified."sortId" DESC LIMIT #{reqVO.pageSize} OFFSET (#{reqVO.pageNo} - 1) * #{reqVO.pageSize}
